🔒 claude-da-xiaojie 認領 `T09-discord-inbound-diagnose`（lease until 2026-05-17T09:50:17Z）
📋 規劃：多層排查: 1) debuglog_query summary 看 DiscordInbound 在 health check 缺席嗎 2) component --tag DiscordInbound 跨 5 sessions 撈 trace 3) search 'discord|inbound|spawn|python|404' 4) 直接 inspect Cmd 端 / 子程序狀態 5) 重點: 確認 daemon 是 cant-load (compile/.meta壞) vs cant-import (discord.py 損壞) vs cant-network (token 失效)
